## Everpure, Inc. (P) `[AI Infrastructure]`
- Multiple insider-sale disclosures were published on October 15, including founder John Colgrove’s sale of 100,000 shares for $15.373 million under a Rule 10b5-1 plan; director Andrew Brown sold 4,268 shares and CAO Mona Chu sold 5,112 shares. (MarketBeat, Oct. 15; publication time not reported)
- Everpure’s latest reported quarter showed revenue of $1.19 billion, up 37.7% year over year, and EPS of $0.70 versus a $0.19 consensus estimate; product revenue was $687 million and subscription revenue was $499 million. (Yahoo Finance, Oct. 15 11:04 ET)
- Subscription annual recurring revenue was approximately $2.13 billion, up 20% year over year. (Yahoo Finance, Oct. 15 11:04 ET)
- The consensus rating was Moderate Buy, with 17 Buy ratings, 4 Hold ratings and 1 Sell rating; the average price target was $143.25. (MarketBeat, Oct. 15; publication time not reported)

## PTC Inc. (PTC) `[Software & SaaS]`
- The U.S. Air Force extended its use of PTC’s Servigistics service-supply-chain optimization solution through the ESCAPE program, extending a relationship that had lasted nearly a decade. (PR Newswire, Oct. 15; publication time not reported)
